title: Biomarkers to differentiate asymptomatic bacteriuria into urinary tract infection or colonization requiring treatment
summary: Das Ziel der Studie ist die Identifikation eines spezifischen Biomarkers oder einer Biomarkerkombination, welche nur bei Patientinnen mit einer akuten Harnwegsinfektion vorkommt und somit in der Zukunft zwischen Harnwegsinfektionen und unge-fährlichen bakteriellen Besiedlungen in der Blase unterscheidet, und so hoffentlich den Einsatz von Antibiotika besser steuern kann.
conditions: Urinary tract infection, site not specified

interventions.name: Female patients with acute urinary tract infection

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Female gender, premenopausal
- Symptomatic, community-acquired, uncomplicated urinary tract infection; defined according to the criteria of the current AWMF guideline (4) BEFORE antibiotic therapy.
- Written informed consent to participate in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
- Evidence of more serious or other urogenital infection including fever, flank pain, renal pelvic palpitation, vaginal discharge, and vaginal pain.
- Pregnancy
- Diabetes mellitus and other relevant metabolic diseases
- Kidney disease
- Taking medications that affect the genitourinary tract
- Immunosuppression
